label: PF Backlog 474
title: Deploy/install: self-host web-search engine (Whoogle/SearXNG) as documented PF prerequisite (+ optional provision)
body:
Source: user request (2026-10-08): "is self-host of web search a backlog item ... when we have our
install/deploy this is one of the things we mention to be self-hosted for PF to work for web search".

Reality: the self-host RECOMMENDATION is documented (BI-PF-0436/0437 TOOLS-AND-DEPENDENCIES.md) and is the
web_search tool's default backend class (BI-PF-0438: whoogle MIT / searxng operator-run), but there is NO
deploy/install artifact that lists "stand up a self-hosted search engine" as a PF prerequisite, and nothing
provisions it.

Scope:
- Make the self-hosted web-search engine (default: Whoogle, MIT) an explicit PF INSTALL/DEPLOY prerequisite:
  documented in the deployment/install path (build->package->deploy, BI-PF-0398) and, where an edition ships
  search enabled, an optional provision step (compose/helm/manifest) that starts Whoogle alongside PF.
- Register the engine in the vendor/tool catalog (BI-0211) with bundle_allowed=false (invoke/self-host, never
  bundle) + license metadata, so the packaging/PR gate keeps it out of the shipped tree.
- Fail-closed: if backend is set but the engine URL is unreachable, web_search reports a clear, actionable
  error (already surfaced by the tool) and install docs say how to fix.

Depends on: BI-PF-0438 (web_search tool) + BI-PF-0439 (settings API sets backend/url).
Related: BI-PF-0398 (build->package->deploy), BI-0211 (vendor catalog), BI-PF-0436/0437 (docs).
